Claim_or_Question: Do job boards contribute 26.9% of hires?
Metric: Job Board share of hires (Source as recorded)
Observed_Value: 7/26 = 26.9% [M-A0]; definition range 23.1% to 30.8% across 7 attribution variants
Calculation_or_Method: Stage=Hired applications joined to Candidates.Source; variants M-A1, M-A2, M-A3, M-A8, M-A9, M-A10
Data_Quality_Impact: Depends on Candidates.Source, which conflicts with Referred By (FND-05)
Product_Decision_Impact: Figure reproduced; does not by itself justify integration work
Caveat: One hire moves the share by 3.8 percentage points

Claim_or_Question: Are job boards a high-volume channel?
Metric: Job Board share of applications
Calculation_or_Method: Applications joined to Candidates.Source
Product_Decision_Impact: Volume is already the largest; volume is not shown to be the constraint
Caveat: No caveat beyond those in the evidence source

Claim_or_Question: How efficiently do job-board applications convert to hires?
Metric: Job Board hire rate per application
Observed_Value: 7/236 = 3.0% [M-A7-Job Board]; range 6/219 = 2.7% to 8/236 = 3.4% across 5 attributions; next-lowest channel with hires 9.7%
Calculation_or_Method: Hires / applications per channel under Source as recorded, referrer override, strict referral, two merged first-touch rules
Evidence_Source: metric_calculations.csv M-A7*, M-A7r*, M-A7s*, M-A7m*, M-A7f*
Data_Quality_Impact: Attribution conflicts move individual hires but not the ranking
Product_Decision_Impact: Primary evidence against prioritising job-board integration in Q3 (N1)
Caveat: Lowest yield does not show what an integration would change; integration friction is unmeasured (C-12)

Claim_or_Question: Do job-board candidates fall behind at interview?
Metric: Offer rate after interview: Job Board
Calculation_or_Method: Offered / interviewed applications, Source as recorded
Product_Decision_Impact: Context for N1; not a basis for an interview feature
Caveat: Other channels have n = 10-16 interviewed applications

Claim_or_Question: Is the referral channel reliably attributed?
Metric: Referral-labelled hires without a referrer link
Observed_Value: 7/7 = 100.0% [M-A9n]; hires with any referrer link 3/26 = 11.5% [M-A9r]; Source vs Referred By conflicts 34/350 = 9.7% [DQ-01]
Calculation_or_Method: Candidates.Source x Applications.Referred By
Data_Quality_Impact: Channel attribution is unreliable at record level
Product_Decision_Impact: Motivates B3; Referral is not a proven high-performing channel (N3)
Caveat: Which field is authoritative is unknown (C-04)

Claim_or_Question: What is offer acceptance at the decision event?
Metric: Decided Offer Acceptance Rate (offer-level; provisional primary)
Calculation_or_Method: Offers accepted at a decision event / offers with a decision event on or before the as-of date (event-time)
Product_Decision_Impact: Primary D3 metric (DEC-016, DEC-029, DEC-038)
Caveat: No target or benchmark exists (C-13)

Claim_or_Question: Where does the VP's ~72% come from?
Metric: All-Issued Offer Acceptance Ratio
Calculation_or_Method: Accepted / all counted offers including Pending
Data_Quality_Impact: Counts unresolved Pending offers as non-acceptance
Product_Decision_Impact: Kept as a separately labelled ratio, not the acceptance rate
Caveat: Scenario range: stale Pending as expired 26/34 = 76.5%; upper bound 31/36 = 86.1%

Claim_or_Question: Is candidate-level acceptance different?
Metric: Candidate-level decided acceptance (secondary)
Calculation_or_Method: Candidates with at least 1 accepted offer / candidates with at least 1 decided offer
Product_Decision_Impact: Reported separately; never combined with offer-level OAM-01
Caveat: Different grain from OAM-01

Claim_or_Question: Are Pending offers really pending?
Metric: Pending offers carrying a Decision On
Calculation_or_Method: Status = Pending AND Decision On present; age at provisional cutoff 2026-08-27
Product_Decision_Impact: Core motivation for B1
Caveat: Cutoff unconfirmed: at 2026-11-24 all 5 are older than 30 days and the stale-as-expired scenario equals 26/36 = 72.2%

Claim_or_Question: Are offers made to people already hired?
Metric: Offers to candidates already hired via another application
Calculation_or_Method: Earlier Hired application with decision before this offer
Product_Decision_Impact: Flagged in D3; OAM-01b variant excludes them
Caveat: Possibly internal moves (C-08)

Claim_or_Question: Are offer and closing dates consistent?
Metric: Applications closed before the offer decision
Observed_Value: hires 17/26 = 65.4% [DQ-18]; declines 4/5 = 80.0% [DQ-26]; offer start before decision 4/35 = 11.4% [R10-dates]
Calculation_or_Method: Applications.Closed On vs Offers.Decision On; Offers date order
Product_Decision_Impact: Hire date taken from the decision event (DEC-011); B1 records event dates

Claim_or_Question: Where does the funnel lose applications?
Metric: Evidence-based stage reach (full snapshot)
Calculation_or_Method: Screened On present; at least 1 interview; at least 1 offer; Stage Hired
Product_Decision_Impact: Context; no funnel feature is in Q3 scope
Caveat: Interview counts are a lower bound (FND-16)

Claim_or_Question: Does a completed cohort tell the same story?
Metric: Completed cohort (applications 2025-07-01 to 2026-03-31)
Observed_Value: eligible 134; hired 12/134 = 9.0%; interviewed->offered 16/50 = 32.0%; offers still pending 2/16 = 12.5%
Calculation_or_Method: Closed or stalled (>90 days) applications in window (DEC-021, DEC-022)
Data_Quality_Impact: Eligibility rule is an analyst proposal (DEC-022)
Product_Decision_Impact: Confirms the snapshot shape
Caveat: Offer->hire step n = 16

Claim_or_Question: Are Active applications actually being worked?
Metric: Active applications with no activity > 90 days
Calculation_or_Method: Latest of applied, screened, interview, offer, decision dates vs provisional cutoff
Data_Quality_Impact: Inactivity is a flag, not confirmed abandonment
Product_Decision_Impact: Motivates B2; Pilot 1 is the stop condition
Caveat: Highly threshold- and cutoff-sensitive (104/105 at 2026-11-24, DQ-28 detail)

Claim_or_Question: Does opening status match hiring activity?
Metric: Openings whose Status contradicts their applications
Calculation_or_Method: Status and headcount vs hired/Active applications
Data_Quality_Impact: Fill rate and open-requisition counts unreliable
Product_Decision_Impact: B2 raises review flags; never auto-corrects
Caveat: DQ-12 is cutoff-sensitive

Claim_or_Question: Are interview dates consistent?
Metric: Interview chronology and copy-vs-source agreement
Observed_Value: interview before application 9/160 = 5.6% [R10-dates]; copied First Interview On differs from Interviews table 13/143 = 9.1% [DQ-15]; Final Interview On after every recorded interview 44/50 = 88.0% [DQ-16]
Calculation_or_Method: Pairwise date checks; Applications copied fields vs Interviews table
Evidence_Source: dq_issues.csv DQ-13, DQ-15, DQ-16; phase2_1_checks.csv R10-*
Product_Decision_Impact: No interview feature in Q3 (X1 backlog)
Caveat: Interviews table may lack rounds; scope unknown (C-05)

Claim_or_Question: Are there duplicate candidate identities?
Metric: Candidates in name+phone pairs
Observed_Value: 12/300 = 4.0% [DQ-02]; same candidate hired twice 4/26 = 15.4% [DQ-04]; the name+phone warning would fire on 6 groups and on 0 name-only collisions
Calculation_or_Method: Normalised full name AND phone
Data_Quality_Impact: 4/6 pairs have experience values implausible for one person (DQ-02 detail)
Product_Decision_Impact: B3 warning-only duplicate check; first scope cut
Caveat: Whether pairs are the same people is unconfirmed (C-07)

Claim_or_Question: Does any department explain outcomes?
Metric: Engineering hires per application
Calculation_or_Method: Applications by opening department
Data_Quality_Impact: Engineering opening REQ-2026-017 Filled with 0 hires (DQ-11)
Product_Decision_Impact: No department feature; question C-10
Caveat: Every department has fewer than 10 decided offers (OAM-07)

Claim_or_Question: Can compensation explain declines?
Metric: Offers far from candidate Expected CTC
Calculation_or_Method: Base CTC / Expected CTC outside 0.67-1.5x
Data_Quality_Impact: No units defect found; candidates often outside the role's band
Product_Decision_Impact: Rules out comp-driven tooling (N2)
Caveat: Currency/period assumed INR annual (ASM-016)

Claim_or_Question: Can feedback latency be measured?
Metric: Interviews with Completed On equal to Scheduled On
Calculation_or_Method: Count of equal dates; no feedback timestamp exists
Product_Decision_Impact: No feedback-latency feature can be evidenced
Caveat: No caveat beyond those in the evidence source

Claim_or_Question: What date does the data describe?
Metric: Records bulk-created within one minute
Calculation_or_Method: createdTime range; date fields after import
Product_Decision_Impact: Ages and stale counts shown at 3 cutoffs
